title: BananaSMP
description: A classic SMP with a home spawn, a working economy system, and unique banana events. Build, trade, and enjoy exciting adventures in an active community! 🍌
body: A classic SMP server featuring a cozy home spawn, a balanced economy system, and fun, unique banana-themed events. Build your base, trade with others, and explore a lively world full of adventures and an active community! 🍌
